answer: Mount Morgan (GSQ site 494270): what might remain today, from official services and registers checked on 2026-11-23; each record carries its source, the query URL and the check time. Exploration: 15 mineral boreholes within 2 km listed (nearest MOUNT MORGAN MINE 5-28 at 515 m, MOUNT MORGAN LIMITED; no drill dates recorded); no MINOCC-linked company report. Resources: 1 record, each a modern reported resource (JORC/as published), not historical production and not a claim about what remains: Mount Morgan Gold as at 2012-12-31 (JORC code): indicated resource 2.5 Mt at 1.6 g/t, about 128,089 troy ounces contained (derived); inferred resource 5.9 Mt at 1.07 g/t, about 201,592 troy ounces contained (derived). Access: nearest town Mount Morgan (2.1 km, population 2558); nearest major road JAMES STREET A3 (1.9 km; national or state highway, sealed); nearest operational power line Calvale to Stanwell 275 kV (4.4 km); straight-line distance, not route distance. Environment: 5 environmental authorities listed (1 over the site point, for example EPML00433013 HERITAGE MINERALS PTY LTD, granted); 9 abandoned-mines records (program site MOUNT MORGAN PS0023, Priority), 7 of them tailings; 0 recorded mine openings within 2 km. Not found or not checked: exploration: the MINOCC 2017 database links no company report (CR) number to this site; environment: contaminated-land and environmental-management registers: no keyless official spatial layer was found among the Queensland map services (layer names searched 2026-11-23), so they are not checked. Note: exploration: 15 mineral boreholes within 2 km; 0 with a rig-release date, 15 without; operators named: MOUNT MORGAN LIMITED, PERILYA MINES NL, GEOPEKO LIMITED; resources: Mount Morgan (ENO 333486, 0.6 km, location accuracy 2000 m); 2 resource records across all reporting dates, the latest per zone and commodity listed (1); earlier reporting dates are not listed. These records show what has been drilled, reported, mapped or registered near the site. They are not an estimate of gold remaining and say nothing about whether any deposit is economic; that needs a geologist. Modern reported resources are kept apart from historical production.

remaining_caveat: These records show what has been drilled, reported, mapped or registered near the site. They are not an estimate of gold remaining and say nothing about whether any deposit is economic; that needs a geologist. Modern reported resources are kept apart from historical production.

caveats.exploration: A borehole or company report near the site is evidence that exploration took place, not of what it found: no assay or result is given here. Boreholes are those on the Geological Survey of Queensland mineral boreholes layer; many have no drill date recorded.
caveats.resources: Each figure is modern reported resource (JORC/as published), not historical production and not a claim about what remains. Tonnes, grade and category are as published by Geoscience Australia from company reports; contained metal is derived here as tonnes times grade and is not a published figure.
caveats.access: All distances are straight-line distance, not route distance; they say nothing about road condition, legal access or the cost of connecting power.
caveats.environment: A register or abandoned-mines record is not an assessment of liability, contamination or rehabilitation cost. Contaminated-land and environmental-management registers were not available as keyless spatial layers and are not checked.
